reference_basis.documented: LOAD_STATUS checks program code and any initialized variable; GET/SET_ATTR_PRG select INTEGER or STRING values with status; capacities and read-only/running restrictions are listed
reference_basis.uncertainty: Native enum numbers, initialization of portable resources and complete failure output states are not authenticated

implementation_choices.identity: Case-insensitive ASCII program identifier, 1..36 characters; attached current/variable-store/task Programs and live linked frames; ProgramCatalog listings do not imply load state
implementation_choices.initialization: Any known global content across attached instances, partial aggregates and imported references; constants/locals excluded; all branches validated before either output; cycle/depth guards
implementation_choices.resources: Open FILE, a PATH node or known header content, and initialized QUEUE_TYPE count; unknown BYTE and SHORT sentinel do not
implementation_choices.snapshots: Explicit ProgramAttributes flags and named typed values; absent flags false; attached data overrides snapshot load flags; explicit active still blocks writes
implementation_choices.attributes: Derived attached KAREL type, normalized identity truncated to 12 and source COMMENT fallback; other reads require supplied metadata
implementation_choices.writes: Only owner, comment, source name and source version; explicit service, checked/truncated values, activity and live linked-frame guards; plain run activity cleared in finally
implementation_choices.identifiers: Named portable AT_* selectors and PT_* kinds, independent of native numbers
implementation_choices.status: 0 success, 1 missing program, 2 unknown/read-only/unmodeled selector, 3 unsupplied read metadata, 4 active target; invalid selector checked first
implementation_choices.evaluation: Every argument once in source order including both SET values; selected GET value output only; generic exact/disjoint output checks and transitive FOR protection
implementation_choices.persistence: Detached program_attributes JSON mapping; metadata snapshots and completed writes only, no executable/task checkpoints
implementation_choices.reports: program_metadata_policy and source-located service_operations; value-free runtime service observations

retained_boundaries: No controller discovery, file/module loading or implicit executable registration
No namespace rename, task priority/protection/abort/pause policy mutation, invented sizes or timestamps
No native enum/status, resource initialization or controller runtime equivalence claim; strict remains future work
